verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a Core RESTful API, a JavaScript SDK and a CLI. However, nothing in the evidence mentions API versioning, version pinning, or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Simply having an API does not satisfy a story about versioned APIs with a deprecation policy, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
